document.abstract: The problems of time-lapse cinemicrography of cell cultures differ greatly from those of still photomicrography of fixed preparations. The cost of commercial equipment for a complete setup is too high for the small laboratory. Utilizing existing equipment, some purchased components and some equipment constructed by the engineering department of the Isaac Albert Research Institute, a time-lapse unit was assembled. Available components and the specially designed repetitive electronic flash unit, incubator and pump are discussed.
